evals.name: paginate-bug
evals.prompt: /fuji paginate() in paginate/pager.py loses the last item when the list has an odd length. fix it.
evals.expected_output: Root-cause fix of the range bound, regression test for odd lengths, test run shown, related page_count floor bug noticed.
assertions: paginate([1,2,3],2) returns [[1,2],[3]] after the change (run in outputs/paginate)
Fix changes the range bound itself rather than adding a special-case guard for the last item
A regression test covering an odd-length list exists and passes
Final reply flags page_count floor bug (3 items, size 2 gives 1)
Final reply opens with the goal and the smallest change
Final reply tags claims as measured, inferred, or guess

evals.name: report-csv
evals.prompt: /fuji add a --csv option to report/report.py so it prints name,score lines instead of the padded table.
evals.expected_output: Data shape named, dead legacy_format and one-caller wrapper removed or flagged, small diff, both modes run on scores.csv.
assertions: python report/report.py report/scores.csv --csv prints alice,90 / bob,72 / carol,85
Default output without --csv is unchanged padded table
Final reply names the data shape (rows as (name, score) tuples) before or alongside the change
Dead legacy_format and/or one-caller _format_row_impl wrapper removed or explicitly flagged
Final reply tags claims as measured, inferred, or guess

evals.name: parallel-review
evals.prompt: /fuji review paginate/ and report/ for bugs in parallel, one worker per folder, then give me one combined list.
evals.expected_output: Backend resolved and stated (Herdr here), two children with worker.md first line, reports via files, panes closed, combined deduped list with evidence tags.
assertions: log.md states the delegation backend chosen and why (named > herdr > pi-subagents > inline)
Two workers were actually spawned, one per folder
Each worker brief's first line reads fuji worker.md
Combined list includes the paginate off-by-one and page_count floor bugs
Combined list includes report.py load() crash on malformed/blank lines
No code under paginate/ or report/ was edited
Any Herdr panes created were closed
